editorial.blurb: Mis Moles is a warm, welcoming spot where three housemade moles steal the show—arrive early to taste them all with complimentary chips before you order.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask to try all three moles with chips when you're seated; this tasting ritual helps you choose your perfect match, whether you prefer the green mole (spicier) or the red mole (rich and medium-spicy).
